# CopilotForge - Change and Communications

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-port.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Build sponsorship, communications, manager engagement, behavioural reinforcement and change readiness.

- **Layer:** adoption
- **Lead role:** Change Lead
- **Plugin name:** `copilotforge-change-and-communications`

| Skill | Status | Lifecycle | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`adoption-campaign-plan`](skills/adoption-campaign-plan/SKILL.md) | draft | Launch, Measure, Scale, Improve | Plans a time-boxed adoption campaign of a few weeks around one scenario theme for a defined audience - the behaviour it should change, tested scenarios, a weekly arc, tasks for managers and Champions, assets, a team-level baseline and a closing review that hands practice to reinforcement. Use when a scenario is under-used, when a new capability needs a push, or when leaders want a campaign but cannot say what it should change. |
| [`ai-communication-strategy`](skills/ai-communication-strategy/SKILL.md) | draft | Envision, Mobilise, Enable, Launch, Scale | Sets the communication strategy for an AI change - the narrative and core messages, honest answers to hard questions on jobs, monitoring and data, an audience, message, sender and channel matrix, a phased calendar, listening routes and the approval path for sensitive messages. Use when an AI programme needs to reach the workforce, when messages conflict or ring hollow, or before a wave, policy change or new AI experience is announced. |
| [`ai-stakeholder-mapping`](skills/ai-stakeholder-mapping/SKILL.md) | draft | Envision, Mobilise, Launch, Scale | Maps the stakeholders of an AI change by role and group - their interests, influence on the outcome, stated concerns about AI such as jobs, monitoring, quality and ethics, and the engagement each needs - so HR, employee representatives, functions and affected teams are involved early rather than told late. Use when an AI programme or wave is starting, when a group pushes back unexpectedly, or when engagement has been launch emails only. |
| [`behaviour-reinforcement-plan`](skills/behaviour-reinforcement-plan/SKILL.md) | draft | Launch, Measure, Scale, Improve | Plans how new AI-enabled ways of working are embedded so they stick - naming target behaviours, then building them into processes, templates, team routines, role expectations, onboarding and leadership routines, removing old-way pull-backs and handing ownership to the business. Use when adoption gains fade after launch or a campaign, when new practice depends on enthusiasts, or before a programme hands over to business as usual. |
| [`change-network`](skills/change-network/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Enable, Launch, Scale | Builds and runs a change network of local change agents alongside Champions - agents carry messages into units, gather concerns and readiness signals and feed back, while Champions build capability - with coverage, manager-agreed time, a briefing and feedback cycle, boundaries and one coordinated ask of managers. Use when change lands unevenly across units, when feedback never reaches the programme, or when Champions are doing change work. |
| [`manager-enablement`](skills/manager-enablement/SKILL.md) | draft | Enable, Launch, Measure, Scale | Equips line managers to lead AI adoption in their own teams - a briefing before their team hears anything, conversation guides for purpose and concerns, team norms for approved use and verification, protected practice time, a monthly question and clear routes for ideas and issues - without asking managers to monitor individuals. Use when managers are bypassed or unsure, before a wave reaches their teams, or when teams stall. |
| [`people-change-impact`](skills/people-change-impact/SKILL.md) | draft | Envision, Mobilise, Enable, Scale | Assesses how an AI change affects each group of people - tasks, skills, workload, decisions and accountability, tools, team routines and role expectations - with the group's readiness and capacity for change, any consultation needs, and the support each group requires, assessed by role group and never by person. Use when AI will change how a role works, before waves or curricula are planned, or when staff ask what AI means for their jobs. |
| [`resistance-management`](skills/resistance-management/SKILL.md) | draft | Enable, Launch, Measure, Improve | Understands and responds to resistance, fear and scepticism about AI as information about the change - listening at group level, diagnosing causes such as job fear, monitoring worries, quality doubts, ethical objection, workload and change fatigue, separating legitimate risks from misunderstanding, and choosing a fitting response with an owner. Use when a group pushes back, when fear or rumour spreads, or when scepticism stalls adoption. |
| [`success-stories`](skills/success-stories/SKILL.md) | draft | Launch, Measure, Scale, Improve | Captures and shares credible success stories about Microsoft AI at work - chosen for real work, evidence and a visible verification step, checked with value owners, cleared for consent and data, honest about limits, and kept in a story bank with review dates. Use when the programme needs proof people will believe, when stories carry inflated or untraceable claims, or when a sponsor wants examples to share. |
